objects.phase_space: E x E, ordered as position then velocity
objects.reflection: g_r(x)=grad V(x)-grad V(r); S_r(x,v)=(x,v-2<v,g_r(x)>/||g_r(x)||^2 g_r(x)); zero denominator gives identity
objects.prefix: ordered simplex 0<t_1<...<t_n<T, represented as subtype; singleton when n=0
objects.records_and_histories: Rec=(NNReal x (E x E)) disjoint-union Unit; Hist(n)=Fin(n+1)->Rec; K_j=live(t_j,z_j)
objects.path: Psi visits records in ascending index order, replacing value with Phi(y,r,s-a,z) for eligible live records a<=s; Gamma=Psi(K)

domains.ambient: finite-dimensional real inner-product Borel space, including dimension zero
domains.test: measurable F:((E x E) x Prefix(n,T))->ENNReal
domains.integrals: ENNReal-valued nonnegative Lebesgue integrals; real interval integral only inside Lambda

quantifiers: For every admissible E,V,alpha,beta,eta satisfying all listed hypotheses
For every prefix t and coordinate i:Fin n, revTimes(t)_i=T-t_(n-1-i)
For every y,r:E using that same revTimes
For every F of the stated type, Measurable F implies the integral equality
Initial phase states and prefixes are integration variables under ell.prod(m)
assumptions: NormedAddCommGroup E; InnerProductSpace R E; FiniteDimensional R E
For every x,v:E, alpha||v||^2 <= D(DV)(x)[v][v] <= beta||v||^2
Measurable F; no boundedness or integrability assumption

conclusion.existence: Coordinate-reversing reflected time map exists on each prefix simplex
conclusion.identity: lintegral W(p)*F(Theta(p)) d(ell.prod(m)) = lintegral W(p)*F(p) d(ell.prod(m))
conclusion.value_domain: Extended nonnegative reals, with infinite values permitted and 0*infinity=0
conclusion.measure_order: First phase state, whose components are position then velocity; second prefix times

scopes.definitions_not_hypotheses: All let-bound objects are fixed explicitly by ambient parameters
scopes.fixed_count: Each identity is for one n and T; no sum over n, normalized law, or stochastic process claim
scopes.endpoint_only: F is a test on initial phase state plus prefix; Theta uses terminal path value and reversed prefix, not a path-valued test
scopes.zero_count: Singleton prefix, q=1, terminal survival exp(-Lambda(z_0,T)), terminal flow Phi_T(z_0)
scopes.zero_horizon: For n>0 empty prefix and zero integrals; for n=0 singleton prefix, density 1 and Theta=velocity flip
scopes.zero_dimension: Allowed; rates zero and positive-count densities zero
scopes.zero_gradient_difference: Reflection is identity by totalized real division; rate zero
scopes.cemetery: Defined on generic histories but never occurs in K used for the final identity
scopes.unbounded_test: F may take infinity; no signed or real-integrable-test extension is stated

constant_dependencies.rho_time_reversal: Chosen for n,T before y,r; formula depends only on n,T and prefix t
constant_dependencies.curvature_constants: alpha,beta occur in hypotheses, not as extra multiplicative factors in definitions or conclusion
constant_dependencies.new_constants: None; no hidden normalization, factorial, dimension factor, or estimate constant
